properties.displayName: [AZ-02] Audit NSG rules allowing 0.0.0.0/0 ingress on TCP/22 or TCP/3389
properties.description: Audits Microsoft.Network/networkSecurityGroups with an inbound Allow rule on port 22 or 3389 sourced from 0.0.0.0/0 or *. Mirrors azure/arg/AZ-02.kql. Known false positive: jump-host NSGs where the broad source is intentional — use Microsoft.Authorization/policyExemptions rather than editing the rule.
